info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Support Tickets Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Status API provides a mechanism for users to retrieve the current status of support tickets in an efficient manner. This endpoint allows clients to query the status of previously submitted support tickets, helping them stay informed about the progress and any updates. Ideal for support teams and customer service applications, this API enables organizations to enhance their customer experience by providing timely information regarding ticket resolutions. Users can easily integrate this endpoint into their systems to automate ticket status tracking.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of various tickets within the system. You can use this to check if a ticket is open, closed, or in progress, providing insights into ticket management.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of tickets. This body should contain any required parameters to specify the status query.

ListSupportTicketsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET ticket status operation. It expects a string value that contains relevant information related to the ticket status.
